title: OP Hammer
description: This mod add a OP hammer that can launch projectiles. It has a few small bugs, but I plan to fix them later.
body:
OP Hammer 🔨⚡
Add a powerful new weapon to your adventure! The OP Hammer is not just a normal melee weapon — it can also launch devastating projectiles, combining raw strength with magical abilities.

Perfect for players looking for a unique combat experience, this legendary hammer brings a new way to fight and dominate your enemies.

✨ Features:

Extremely powerful hammer weapon
Launches projectiles from a distance

⚠️ The mod is still in development: a few bugs may be present, but more updates, improvements, and fixes are planned for the future.
